$comment: LotRace proportion scale — SimCity BuildIt language: grid-based footprint with strongly exaggerated visual height. The building footprint is controlled, but its drawn height can be several grid units, giving a 'living mini-city' feel instead of a digitised Monopoly. Sizes map to CSS container-query units (cqw/cqh/cqmin) since each .board-tile is a container.

lots.$comment: Phase B target grid. Corners 3x3, standard lots 2x2, large 3x2. 3 + 9*2 + 3 = 24 per side.

player.$comment: Car ~ the visual width of the road so the player instantly finds their piece (BuildIt intent). Footprint small; it is a marker.

buildings.$comment: footprint = ground units; visualHeight = drawn height in grid units (exaggerated). The taller the asset, the more it may overlap the tile behind (accepted, BuildIt-style), controlled via z-index so it never covers a neighbour's name.

phaseA.$comment: Applied NOW without changing the 7x7 ring grid. Piece language only: car ~ road width, buildings with exaggerated visual height via the SVG viewBox. cqmin values relative to the current (narrow) tile.
phaseA.towerVisualHeightBoost: stretch the hotel/tower SVG taller than wide
